newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec in $140 mln India ventures.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec in $140 mln India ventures.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday its joint ventures with an Indian firm would invest a total of $140 million to build consumer electronics plants by April 1998.

Daewoo Electronics and India's Anchor Electronics and Electrical Ltd will jointly build a $100 million plant to make refrigerators and washing machines and a $40 million plant to produce colour television sets, a Daewoo spokesman said.
Daewoo will have a 76 percent stake in both plants in India, which are due to start commercial production in April 1998.
The white goods plant in the Ranjiangaon industrial complex near Pune will be capable of making 200,000 refrigerators and 200,000 washing machines a year.
The TV plant in the Noida industrial complex near New Delhi will have an annual capacity of 400,000 units.
